title: Bright Engine Druqks
description: A bright, propulsive 707 cut that rides a driving square-wave arpeggio through two peaks split by a hushed, delay-soaked valley. The arp mutates register and pattern as filters bloom, hats and claps snap in and out, and the groove stays funky and forward-leaning throughout.
code:
setcpm(132/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.0),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf(900).delay(".3:.1875:.4")
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.05),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.42).cut(1).degradeBy(0.15),
    n("0 2 4 7 4 2 0 <3 5>").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.48).lpf("<1100 1500 2000 2600>/2").delay(".3:.1875:.45")
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.62),
    s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.46).cut(1).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    n("<0 5>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.18).sustain(0.1).gain(0.5).lpf(700),
    n("0 2 4 7 [9 7] 4 <11 7> 2").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.52).lpf("<1800 2400 3000 3600>/2").delay(".35:.1875:.5")
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ ~ cp ~").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5),
    n("<0 3 5 2>").scale("C3:minor").s("triangle").attack(0.06).decay(0.4).sustain(0.4).release(0.3).gain(0.5).lpf(1200),
    n("0 4 7 <9 11>").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.12).sustain(0).gain(0.44).lpf("<900 1400>/2").delay(".4:.25:.6")
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.1),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.64),
    s("hh*16").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.44).cut(1).degradeBy(0.1),
    s("~ oh").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    n("<0 5 3 7>").scale("C2:minor").s("square").decay(0.18).sustain(0.1).gain(0.52).lpf(800),
    n("0 4 7 9 <11 12> 9 7 <4 2>").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.54).lpf("<2600 3200 3800 4400>/2").delay(".35:.1875:.55").every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.95),
    n("0 2 4 7").scale("C4:minor").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(0.42).lpf("<1200 800>/2").delay(".4:.25:.5")
  )]
)
